study: Does distant vacancy packing predict tripod versus opposed-pair organization at fixed local coordination? Static archive proxy and prospective blind boundary forecasts.
scope: Existing independent periodic L=20 endpoints only. No new configurations, dynamics, or cavity simulation. The result can establish predictive association, not why a configuration formed, replica recurrence, point-to-set order, or a new phase.

central_question.eligibility: Vacant center; exactly three vacancies among its six axial nearest neighbors. Match the sorted triple of total occupied nearest-neighbor coordinations of the three OCCUPIED axial neighbors. No species matching or species input. These occupied neighbors each see the vacant center, so each coordination is at most five. Both arrangements have identical center coordination and seven-site cross density.

classes.1: Vacancy tripod: one vacant arm along each cubic axis (eight orientations).
classes.0: T: an opposite pair of vacant arms and one lateral vacant arm (twelve orientations).

central_question.single_signature: Use the full native index-9 TRAIN center census only. Maximize harmonic mean 2*n_tripod*n_T/(n_tripod+n_T), excluding absent classes. Lexicographically smallest sorted triple breaks ties. Freeze and reuse; never pool or switch strata on a scored cohort.
central_question.estimand: P(tripod | center belongs to either matched arrangement, shell). A blind forecast does not assert that its center will be eligible. The two orbit multiplicities do not imply equal class priors.

input: Exactly the 386 offsets of max(|dz|,|dy|,|dx|)=4 in [-4,4]^3, lexicographic (z,y,x), periodic about anchor, little-endian packed uint8 with vacant=1. Shell occupancy only; no center, near-shell, outer sites, species, identity, coordinate, signature, label or eligibility as a feature. All geometric summaries are invariant under signed cubic axis permutations.

cohorts.fit: All native TRAIN parents of index 9 only. Deterministic PCG64 seed 210491 permutation of registered parent order: first floor(n/5) tune, remainder fit. Entire parent always stays on one side. No validation/test parent contributes to training, standardization, regularization selection, classifier selection or signature selection.
cohorts.bank_sampling: Bank census selects all eligible centers up to its predeclared per-parent cap, otherwise uniform subsampling without replacement with weight eligible/retained. Fit AND tuning then cap at 12 bank centers per parent: order by parent and flat anchor, sample uniformly without replacement with PCG64([210491, archive parent row]), multiply bank weight by bank count/retained. Same rows and weights for every candidate. No second cap at scoring.
cohorts.assessment: Single primary: first 1024 native VALIDATION parents at index 9, including those contributing zero eligible centers. Unchanged FULL native validation of indices 8 and 0 thereafter: descriptive only. No index 6, test fold, rescue, new signature, retuning or refitting.
cohorts.issue: Last 1024 native index-9 VALIDATION parents, disjoint from primary. Bank selects exactly one unconditional anchor per parent using its predeclared independent stream before looking at any interior. Retain ALL rows regardless of forecast or actual eligibility. Input bank has no y.

candidate_models.ordinary_features: Shell vacancy fraction and fractions on every orbit of sorted absolute coordinates; shell-density-centered pair products averaged over all pairs at cubic displacements 001,011,111,002,012,022,004,008 and all antipodal pairs. Fourier order probes: shell-centered power averaged/maximized over signed cubic stars of wavevectors 001,011,111 at periods 2,4,5 (lattice units), complex modulus removes phase. Disorder and crystal probes are competing explanations, not candidate labels.
candidate_models.crystal_templates: Enumerate all 28 pairs among the eight period-two sublattices (exactly 25% bulk vacancies). For each edge-, face-, and body-diagonal spacing take maximum shell Pearson overlap over that entire orbit, allowing all translations and rotations. Also include all four boundary_templates.packing20 features for the analytic minimum-energy period 2x2x5 NH crystal-cell family at the archived composition: best centered packing overlap, mean best over three axis orientations, best axis phase-variation RMS, and gap between best and median orientations. Only projected vacancy patterns enter the classifier. The exact template implementation digest enters the cold lock.
candidate_models.ordinary_fits: Weighted Jeffreys-smoothed intercept; separate L2 logistic regressions on density alone, density plus cubic density/pairs, crystal templates only, Fourier only, and all conventional features together (C=0.1). Also two weighted histogram gradient-boosted classifiers on ALL conventional features: 100 stages, learning rate .05, max leaves 7/15, min leaf 64, L2=5, 63 bins and no row-random early stopping. These frozen feature-family comparators provide interpretable ablations; do not choose a new winner on validation.
candidate_models.learned: In addition to ALL conventional features, pool shell-only local shapes. For every one of the 294 complete 3x3 tangent windows on the six faces, map its exact occupancy word to the lexicographically minimum integer code under the eight in-plane square symmetries. Normalize a pooled orbit histogram. A supervised 8-tanh-unit bottleneck mixes these multi-site angular patch frequencies and conventional summaries; scalar logistic head. Jointly train all weights and biases by weighted Bernoulli cross-entropy, 16 epochs of Adam, 512 examples/batch, lr=.002, seeded at 210491. Select between L2 penalties .001/.02. No target used to define patches.
candidate_models.selection: Normalize fitting weights to mean one. Standardization/scale floors use fit rows only (weighted SD floored at 1e-6, standardized values clipped at +/-8); trees use raw features. For each family independently maximize weighted mean log probability on the same disjoint TRAIN tuning parents; lexicographic model name breaks exact ties. Freeze selected learned and strongest ordinary model, all conventional diagnostic models and fit-only scaling without refitting. Require both outcomes on each TRAIN partition and finite tuning probabilities. Probabilities clipped to [1e-7,1-1e-7] identically at selection, evaluation and issuance. One numerical thread, fixed 256-shell feature batches.
candidate_models.locking: Pin cold-lock.json SHA256 BEFORE reading validation/issue banks. Lock records signature, model winners and scores, training cohort evidence, model bytes, feature and software provenance including analytic template source. Reject mismatched bank mode, registered parent order, lock, signature, shell geometry, cold source, bank bytes, model, design or implementation.

prediction_and_statistics.static_prediction: The lower endpoint of the two-sided 95% paired whole-parent confidence interval for learned minus cold-selected strongest conventional mean log score is >= +0.001 nat per matched eligible center at index 9. Only this cold result determines the static pass. A lower endpoint below the margin does not establish that either predictor is equivalent or that crystals cause the arrangements. Empty or unidentified intervals are inconclusive, never passes.
prediction_and_statistics.estimator: For parent i let d_i be the weighted sum of paired log-score differences and w_i its total center weight. Estimate G=sum(d_i)/sum(w_i), SE=sqrt[P/(P-1) sum_i(d_i-G w_i)^2]/sum(w_i); use t_(P-1,.975). Retain all P independent registered parents, including empty w_i=d_i=0. If total weight is zero, return null estimate/interval; fewer than two contributing parents yields no interval. This is a center-weighted population target with parent-level uncertainty, not an unweighted average of parent scores.
prediction_and_statistics.diagnostics: Report weighted prevalence, absolute log scores, weighted AUC where both outcomes exist, calibration-in-the-large (mean predicted minus observed with parent interval), learned and strongest comparator versus intercept. No new threshold or calibration fit on validation.
prediction_and_statistics.swapped_shell_null: Randomly pair all registered parents without replacement using fixed PCG64(210492); pair membership does not use eligibility or labels. In both directions, score recipient outcomes against the other parent's weighted distribution of frozen shell-probabilities (analytically integrating donor draws). A given donor belongs to one independent pair only. Exclude both directions if either parent contributes no eligible centers; report support and compare actual vs swapped on exactly that support, and swapped vs intercept. Pair-cluster interval: sum two directional numerators/denominators within each independent pair before applying the same ratio-SE calculation, keeping empty pairs. Secondary negative control, not an alternative success rule.

artifacts.issue_record: Parent and microscopic chain identity, anchor, packed-shell digest, both frozen conditional probabilities and named arrangements (tripod for p>=0.5, otherwise opposed pair plus lateral). No filtering or retrospective center label. Bind the full prediction table to its SHA256 before any independent cavities. No cavity evidence is generated here.
